item.title: [−1] Rupee surges 43 paise to 93.98 per dollar, its biggest gain since mid-October
item.description:
It touched 93.82 intraday on a softer dollar, lower crude and falling US yields after the election. Still down 4.3% in 2026. Strengthening.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Lower rupee earnings

Why it matters: A firmer rupee eases imported inflation and oil costs and improves returns for foreign investors.

Market gauges: Rupee +2, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days
